newsitem.title: KENYA: Two killed, five injured in Sudan bombing raids.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, five injured in Sudan bombing raids.

text.p: At least two civilians were killed and five injured in two separate bombing raids in areas of southern Sudan controlled by the rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) on Thursday, a U.N. aid official said.

Brenda Barton, spokeswoman for the U.N. World Food Programme (WFP) in Nairobi, said planes bombed the towns of Tambura near the border with the Central African Republic and Maridi near the Zairean border.

Barton could not say who carried out the raids but political analysts in Nairobi said the Islamist government in Khartoum routinely bombed areas held by the SPLA, which has been fighting for autonomy since 1983.
"The seriousness of these bombings is that these are civilian areas inhabited by a significant number of aid agency staff," Barton said.
